art_subject: A flame-cloaked archer crouched on a jagged crystal outcrop, bow drawn, an ember trail arcing into shadow.
A tiny luminous will-o'-the-wisp spirit weaving warm golden light between armored allies.
A jagged slab of solidified violet space standing like a fortress wall at a hex's edge.
A heat-shimmer predator coiled at the rift's edge, its outline warping the torn air around it.
A cluster of glossy poisonous berries on a thorned vine, dripping venom onto the battlefield below.
A single stone rose encased in a faint protective shimmer, petals frozen mid-bloom.
A cluster of drifting corpse-lights luring a lone figure off the safe path into the dark.
A drifting haze of glowing spores billowing outward, blurring and slowing anything that chases through it.
Twin bell-shaped violet blossoms chiming in unison, each ring a silent double strike.
A translucent robed figure striding half-phased between the verdant and umbral realms, untouched by either.
A humming construct of interlocked gears and captured light, growing brighter with every foe it consumes.
A jagged shard of a shattered world, doubled edges glinting, flanked by two smaller drifting fragments.
A living storm of crystalline shrapnel orbiting a dark core, twin lightning arcs striking outward.
A floating shard of pure rift-light, untouchable and serene, drifting at the exact seam between two worlds.
A heavy-hoofed mountain beast climbing a sheer obsidian incline with total confidence, uphill ground no obstacle at all.
showcases: R3 (high ground) — ignores the uphill penalty entirely

art_subject: A serpentine creature coiled directly astride the rift tear, drinking deep from the wound with every kill.
showcases: R5 (Riftlight) — permanently grows on any capture made rift-adjacent

art_subject: An armored sentinel standing atop a towering three-tier war-stack, crowned in the wreckage of everything it has buried beneath it.
showcases: R3/R1 (height) — bonus influence while its cell stands tier-3 or taller

art_subject: A small hooded figure planting a banner directly on the rift tear itself, unafraid to garrison the wound between worlds.
showcases: R5 (rift as prize) — bonus influence while standing directly on a rift hex
